title: Among female patients who were between 30 and 60 years old during their 198
question: Among female patients who were between 30 and 60 years old during their 1984 laboratory tests, find those with abnormal red blood cell counts and elevated glutamic oxaloacetic transaminase (GOT ≥ 60). For these patients, return their ID, sex, birthday, admission status, and the percentage of them diagnosed with SLE.

prediction.sql: SELECT P."XCL_058" AS ID, P."XCL_059" AS sex, P."XCL_060" AS birthday, E."XCL_013" AS admission_status, (SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN P2."XCL_064" LIKE '%SLE%' THEN P2."XCL_058" END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(P2."XCL_058") FROM Patient AS P2 WHERE P2."XCL_059" = 'F' AND P2."XCL_058" IN (SELECT L2."XCL_014" FROM Laboratory AS L2 WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', L2."XCL_015") = '1984' AND L2."XCL_016" BETWEEN 30 AND 60 AND L2."XCL_019" < 4200 AND L2."XCL_021" >= 60)) AS sle_percentage FROM Patient AS P INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014" INNER JOIN Examination AS E ON P."XCL_058" = E."XCL_001" WHERE P."XCL_059" = 'F' AND STRFTIME('%Y', L."XCL_015") = '1984' AND L."XCL_016" BETWEEN 30 AND 60 AND L."XCL_019" < 4200 AND L."XCL_021" >= 60 GROUP BY P."XCL_058", P."XCL_059", P."XCL_060", E."XCL_013"

arguments.sql:
SELECT
    P."XCL_058" AS ID,
    P."XCL_059" AS sex,
    P."XCL_060" AS birthday,
    E."XCL_013" AS admission_status,
    (SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN P2."XCL_064" LIKE '%SLE%' THEN P2."XCL_058" END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(P2."XCL_058")
     FROM Patient AS P2
     WHERE P2."XCL_059" = 'F'
       AND EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM Laboratory AS L2
           WHERE L2."XCL_014" = P2."XCL_058"
             AND STRFTIME('%Y', L2."XCL_015") = '1984'
             AND L2."XCL_016" BETWEEN 30 AND 60
             AND L2."XCL_019" < 4200
             AND L2."XCL_021" >= 60
       )
    ) AS sle_percentage
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
INNER JOIN Examination AS E ON P."XCL_058" = E."XCL_001"
WHERE P."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', L."XCL_015") = '1984'
  AND L."XCL_016" BETWEEN 30 AND 60
  AND L."XCL_019" < 4200
  AND L."XCL_021" >= 60
GROUP BY P."XCL_058", P."XCL_059", P."XCL_060", E."XCL_013"

SELECT
    P."XCL_058" AS ID,
    P."XCL_059" AS sex,
    P."XCL_061" AS birthday,
    P."XCL_063" AS admission_status,
    (SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN P2."XCL_064" LIKE '%SLE%' THEN P2."XCL_058" END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(P2."XCL_058")
     FROM Patient AS P2
     WHERE P2."XCL_059" = 'F'
       AND EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM Laboratory AS L2
           WHERE L2."XCL_014" = P2."XCL_058"
             AND STRFTIME('%Y', L2."XCL_015") = '1984'
             AND L2."XCL_016" >= 60
       )
       AND EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM Examination AS E2
           WHERE E2."XCL_001" = P2."XCL_058"
             AND E2."XCL_005" = 1
       )
       AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', L2."XCL_015") AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', P2."XCL_061") AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 30 AND 60
    ) AS sle_percentage
FROM Patient AS P
WHERE P."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS L
      WHERE L."XCL_014" = P."XCL_058"
        AND STRFTIME('%Y', L."XCL_015") = '1984'
        AND L."XCL_016" >= 60
        AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', L."XCL_015") AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', P."XCL_061") AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 30 AND 60
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Examination AS E
      WHERE E."XCL_001" = P."XCL_058"
        AND E."XCL_005" = 1
  )
